item.title: HELLO CLIPY 1.4.0b5 Beta
item.description:
Moves clipboard binary payloads out of SQLite while keeping searchable text metadata in the database.

Uses compact external thumbnails and restores files from their original local path when available.

Synchronizes exact file assets through CloudKit Assets with user-configurable limits of 5 MB per file and 100 MB total by default.

item.title: HELLO CLIPY 1.4.0b4 Beta
item.description:
Detects clipboard histories that exist in CloudKit but were missed by a Mac.

Automatically resets only the saved CloudKit change position and refetches missing records without deleting local history.

Verifies record IDs during incremental synchronization and reports success only after local and server inventories agree.

item.title: HELLO CLIPY 1.4.0b3 Beta
item.description:
Remaps synchronized Finder file paths when Macs use different account names.

Keeps the original path when it is valid, and uses the current user's matching relative path only when that file exists.

Supports modern file URLs and legacy filename clipboard records, including multiple-file selections.

item.title: HELLO CLIPY 1.4.0b2 Beta
item.description:
Fixes CloudKit synchronization for snippet-folder hot keys in the production environment.

Reannounces existing snippet-folder hot-key settings so they can synchronize between Macs.

Keeps synchronization in an error state until the CloudKit upload succeeds, avoiding a false recovery after restarting the app.

item.title: HELLO CLIPY 1.4.0b1 Beta
item.description:
Beta release with an opt-in beta update channel in Preferences.

Synchronizes clipboard-history deletions safely using CloudKit tombstones and improves full-history deletion.

Synchronizes snippet-folder hot keys between Macs.

item.title: HELLO CLIPY 1.3.2
item.description:
Adds full CloudKit history reconciliation and automatically repairs records missing from individual Macs.

Keeps menu-open synchronization fast with incremental updates, while periodic full audits detect count and record-ID differences.

Synchronizes history deletions safely and shows incremental-sync and full-audit status separately in the menu.

item.title: HELLO CLIPY 1.3.1
item.description:
Sets the default clipboard history limit to 100 and prevents zero or invalid limits from deleting saved history.

Synchronizes the history limit and reorder-after-paste setting between Macs signed in to the same iCloud account.

Includes CloudKit synchronization reliability and HELLO CLIPY test-suite fixes.

item.title: HELLO CLIPY 1.3.0
item.description:
Initial HELLO CLIPY release.

Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
